definitions.profit: Normalized m=1, L in {1,5,10}; realized test mean of I(p<t)*[(1-y)-L*y] over ALL applicants; rejection yields 0. Not observed currency profit.
definitions.approval: p(default)<t; equality rejects. Fixed t=0.5 and t=1/(1+L/m), chosen before reading test predictions. At L/m=1 both rules coincide intentionally.
definitions.default_tpr: P(p(default)>=t | TARGET=1, group): detected defaults / actual defaults; TARGET=1 is positive, not successful repayment.
definitions.gaps: Absolute difference between F and M, or <25 and >=25; proportions, not percentage points. Unknown excluded from binary gaps and reported separately. Undefined denominators remain missing.
definitions.age: Existing AGE_GROUP reused: <25 and >=25 based on AGE_YEARS=-DAYS_BIRTH/365.25. A2 says below/above25 without explicit equality; preserved preparation assigns age25 to >=25.
definitions.gender: Existing CODE_GENDER F/M; other or missing values are unknown, checked against saved GENDER_GROUP.
definitions.calibration: 10 fixed-width bins [k/10,(k+1)/10), last includes1; empty bins have n=0 and missing means. Descriptive curve only, no calibration fit.

limitations: All seven Level4 models shown descriptively; A2 applies profit/fairness to accuracy-eligible models. Eligibility and final joint selection are pending.
Single20k cohort and5 search configurations; five-repeat uncertainty is not measured.
Formal bootstrap confidence intervals, DeLong and Bonferroni tests are pending.
No reweighting or group-specific threshold correction; no SHAP. Brier remains in main metrics.
Profit ratios are assumptions; normalized realized averages are not actual lender revenue.
decision_metrics.source: Assignment2 Methods and Materials, pp2-3; preserved fairness.parquet boundary convention

deviations_from_a2: This is a separate exploratory pilot on 20 000 development applications, selected by stratified sampling with seed=42.
Each pair evaluates 5 configurations × 3 CV folds and one automatic refit; this does not replace the main A2 plan of 20 configurations and 5 repeats.
Full working model settings are used (technical=False). SHAP is not computed in this pilot.
interpretation: Parameters are selected by CV log-loss. The test set is used for final evaluation without changing parameters, preprocessing rules or selecting configurations based on test performance.

RQ1 in Assignment 2 considers a core model jointly using accuracy, profit and fairness. rq1_model_comparison provides only a preliminary descriptive comparison of predictive accuracy and probability quality; the pilot does not select a final core model.

RQ2 shows gains from historical information: Level 2/3/4 − Level 1 differences within each model. Positive AP/ROC-AUC differences and negative log-loss/Brier differences indicate improvement on this test set; Level 1 has zero difference as the baseline.
Model order is fixed; a winner, eligibility and thresholds are not selected on the test set.
One refit per pair does not estimate variability across training repeats: confidence intervals, p-values and statistical-significance claims are not produced.
Pending/invalid stages have no test results in the report; missing metrics and a missing Level 1 baseline remain empty and are displayed as -- in LaTeX.
search_and_refit_seconds includes CV and automatic refit; refit_seconds is part of it, so these columns must not be summed. total_pair_seconds includes test loading, evaluation and saving.
Full MLP loss_curve_ and n_iter_ are read only from verified fit_diagnostics.json; CSV contains a compact summary and JSON retains the original attributes.
LaTeX uses UTF-8 and booktabs: the document requires the booktabs package and English text support.
